snippet.title: Dating and Dragons: A Love Quest - Kickstarter Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Dating and Dragons – A Love Quest is a new RPG dating sim launching on PC in 2027. Find love with any of the six love interests as you join them in their adventures, explore perilous dungeons, and fight monsters and traps.

Inspired by TTRPGs like Dungeons & Dragons, the game brings a fresh twist to the dating sim genre, enhancing the narrative richness of visual novels with RPG mechanics.

SUPPORT US ON KICKSTARTER: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/twistedtwenty/dating-and-dragons-a-love-quest?ref=51arb1

WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3049840/Dating_and_Dragons__A_Love_Quest/
Follow our social media channels and stay updated:
Website: https://www.twistedtwenty.com/
Discord: https://discord.gg/kEeEV3HZaW

Voice actor: Nick Atlas
